profiles.name: Brazil
profiles.rateSummary: Excise federal tax (IPI): Normally between 5% and 30%;Federal VATs (PIS/COFINS): Generally a combined rate of 3.65% (cumulative) or 9.25% (non-cumulative); State VAT (ICMS): Normally between 17% and 20% (lower rates apply to inter-state transactions, varying between 4%, 7%, and 12%, and increased rates apply on certain products);Municipal Service Tax (ISS): 2% to 5% (cumulative).

profiles.name: Canada
profiles.rateSummary: Combined federal and provincial/territorial sales taxes range from 5% to 15%.

profiles.name: Ghana

profiles.name: India
profiles.rateSummary: The rate of GST varies from 5% to 28% depending upon the category of goods and services being supplied, the general rate of tax being 18% on majority of goods and services. Additionally, for certain goods, a compensation cess is levied at different rates as prescribed by the government.

profiles.name: Myanmar (Burma)
profiles.rateSummary: There is no VAT in Myanmar. The indirect tax in Myanmar is commercial tax, with the general rate of 5%.
